verdict.rationale: The evidence shows RUN's new-hire onboarding only as UI and self-service flows: employees fill out paperwork and the W-4, and Form I-9 is completed electronically. ADP API Central is documented only generically, as a way to 'automate HR processes' with use-case templates. No evidence shows API endpoints for creating an employee, setting compensation or configuring tax withholding in RUN, so the generic API platform is at most a developer building block and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup
